messages.body_plain:
What is your OS? If it is Ubuntu, you can try to install the bellow packages, then try to reinstall Deducer.

sudo apt-get install libx11-dev libglu1-mesa-dev libxml2-dev

This can help to solve some problems with dependencies.

Described here: http://r-interface.blogspot.com/2012/04/install-r-jgr-and-deducer-in-ubuntu.html

messages.subject: Deducer (and JGR) extremely small on Windows 8.1 (I believe)
messages.subject_clean: Deducer (and JGR) extremely small on Windows 8.1 (I believe)
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

I am attempting to gather screenshots from my students now for reference, but a few of my students using more recent Windows devices (8.1), but NOT all my students using said devices, have extremely small windows for JGR and Deducer.  We have increased the text size but menu options and other buttons/rows in the Data Viewer/etc are still too small to read.  Is there a way to modify the "size" of the UI?

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: Deducer (and JGR) extremely small on Windows 8.1 (I believe)
messages.subject_clean: Deducer (and JGR) extremely small on Windows 8.1 (I believe)
messages.body_plain:
This might be a problem with high-DPI screens and software that doesn't correctly inherit the scaling from Windows (probably a problem in the Java libraries used by Deduce).

The solution, short of rewriting JGR, would be a change in the application compatibility settings for JGR, which on 32-bit systems can be changed by right-clicking on the app, but on 32-bit systems has to be changed in the registry. See this link for details.

http://kynosarges.org/WindowsDpi.html%23OptOut

Alternatively, your students can use the magnification tool or switch to a lower resolution.

Good luck,

Tom
